coach_says: You're fresh (TSB +4, readiness 85, Garmin Productive), so this is a build week — but your load balance shows an aerobic-high shortage alongside excess anaerobic load, so the added quality is tempo/threshold work, not more sprints. Tuesday's committed double stands as your big anaerobic day; the extra quality goes to Thursday, the only reliably dry day, as a sweet-spot session, with the long Zone 2 ride placed Saturday when winds are lightest. Watch HRV Wednesday morning after the Tuesday double — if it drops sharply, downgrade Thursday's tempo to steady Zone 2.

days.session: Workout A — Hip Stability & Core (pre-hard-day friendly)
days.details: Workout A (lunch, 45 min). Warm-up: 5 min bike erg easy + glute bridges 2x12 + band lateral walks 2x10/side. Main: Single-leg Glute Bridge 3x10/side | Bulgarian Split Squat (bodyweight or light DB) 3x8/side | Pull-ups or Lat Pulldown 3x8 | Side Plank with Hip Dip 3x30s/side | Pallof Press 3x10/side | Copenhagen Plank 2x20s/side. Rest 60-90s between sets. Objective: hip stability, single-leg control and core stiffness with deliberately light lower-body loading — Tuesday is a key double hard day, so no heavy quad or spinal loading today.

days.session: Double: AM Hills Road Ride + PM Hard MTB Group Ride
days.details: AM (before work, ~60 min): Hills road ride | Primary objective: threshold climbing | Zone 4 on climbs. 15 min Z2 warm-up, then ride 4-5 hill repeats of 4-6 min at Zone 4 (RPE 8, hard but controlled), spinning easy on descents for recovery, 10 min Z1 cool-down. Ride steady between climbs — resist surging, since your anaerobic load is already over target. If rain makes the road unsafe, replicate on the trainer: 4x6 min @ 100-105% FTP, 4 min easy between. PM (after work, ~90 min): Hard MTB group ride — non-negotiable committed session. Ride to the group, fuel well between sessions (carbs at lunch and pre-ride), and don't add extra efforts at the end. This is the anaerobic stimulus for the week.

Mandatory recovery day after the Tuesday double. 45 min gentle yoga indoors (wet day anyway): emphasis on hip flexor openers, hamstring and glute stretches, thoracic rotation, and 5 min of slow breathing to finish. Nothing above conversational effort. Prioritise an early night — sleep history is your weakest readiness factor.

days.session: Sweet Spot Intervals (outdoor — best weather day)
days.details: Total 50 min | Primary objective: aerobic-high load — closing your tempo/threshold shortage | Zone 3-4 (sweet spot, 88-94% FTP, RPE 7). Best dry day of the week (~21°C, manageable wind) — ride outdoors before or after work. Structure: 10 min progressive Z1-Z2 warm-up, then 2x15 min at sweet spot with 5 min Z1 spinning between, 5 min Z1 cool-down. Keep cadence 85-95 rpm and effort steady — no surges. This session directly addresses the Garmin aerobic-high gap without adding to the anaerobic surplus.

Lunch swim (wet day, pool is the smart choice). Warmup: 200m easy freestyle + 100m as 4x25m drill (catch-up or fingertip drag), 15s rest per 25. Main set: 8x50m aerobic freestyle at steady effort (RPE 5-6), 20s rest between reps; then 4x25m smooth build (easy to strong, not sprinting), 20s rest. Cooldown: 100m very easy mixed strokes. Total: 1000m. Objective: aerobic maintenance and upper-body recovery flush between Thursday's intervals and Saturday's long ride — keep it genuinely easy.

Total 3 h | Primary objective: aerobic base volume | Zone 2 (65-75% FTP, RPE 4-5, conversational throughout). Saturday has the lightest winds of the week (~9 km/h) but showers are possible — take a rain layer and mudguards, or split as 2 h outdoors + 1 h on Zwift if it's tipping down. No intervals: hold steady Z2, keep climbs seated and capped at low Z3, fuel 60-80 g carbs/hour from hour one. This is the biggest aerobic-low deposit of the week and sets up next week's build.

Workout B (50 min, flexible timing). Warm-up: 5 min row or bike easy + bodyweight hinge patterning 2x10 + banded good mornings 2x12. Main: Romanian Deadlift 4x6 (moderate-heavy, RPE 7-8, progressive from last block) | Rear-foot Elevated Split Squat with DBs 3x8/side | Single-leg Hip Thrust 3x10/side | DB Row 3x10/side | Hanging Knee Raise 3x10 | Calf Raise (single-leg) 3x12/side. Rest 2 min on RDLs, 90s elsewhere. Objective: posterior chain and single-leg strength — the main progressive-overload stimulus of the week, placed after the long ride so it never compromises a key session. Legs will feel Saturday's ride, so warm up thoroughly and let bar speed guide load. Finish with 10 min easy stretching.
